Arman: quick flag: noticed some post-apply drift where runtime didn't pick up quota_map for a cohort.
Lia: ugh. is this a propagation bug or a console-state mismatch?
Arman: looks like propagation. apply returned 200 but some routing nodes still saw old config for ~3m.
Hiro: can we add a post-apply reconciliation step: verify config hash on a sampled set of nodes and fail apply if mismatch?
Marta: +1. propose: after apply completes, run async verify against 10% of nodes for 2min. if mismatch > 2 nodes, mark snapshot state=degraded and rollback quarantine.
Lia: need to surface this in console: show "verification pending" and then result. give teams ability to wait or abort.
Hiro: telemetry: emit `config_postapply_verify_total{result="ok|mismatch|timeout"}` and `config_postapply_mismatch_topology_count`. keep snapshot_id out of high-cardinality labels.
SRE: watch metric cardinality. store node sampling as logs/traces with node ids, but metrics should be aggregate only.
Arman: audit: log lines like `cfg_verify snapshot_hash=abcd initiator=arman checked_nodes=42 mismatches=2 verdict=degraded`.
Marta: guardrail: for critical configs (origin=prod, affects>50 routes), require verification window 5m and stricter mismatch threshold (>=1 node triggers rollback).
Lia: ops: what should rollback behavior be? automatic revert or quarantine and page oncall?
Marta: auto-quarantine first: disable routing change but keep snapshot archived and create an incident draft. auto-rollback only if mismatch persists for 3m after quarantine.
Hiro: also add a dry-verify endpoint: GET /v1/configs/{id}/verify?cohort=10 which runs verification without applying. useful for canary checks.
Arman: console UX: show verification progress, sampled node map, top mismatched keys, and link to traces. if quarantined show "request rollback" CTA.
SRE: implement rate limits on verify runs to avoid load. also ensure verification RPCs use low-priority routes to not impact SLOs.
Marta: ops-bot create ticket CFG-DRIFT-21 with owners @Marta,@SRE to track verify + quarantine flow pls.
ops-bot: created CFG-DRIFT-21 assigned to @Marta, @SRE https://tickets/redwood/CFG-DRIFT-21 :white_check_mark:
Lia: timeline? can we ship minimal verify + metric by next week and UI after?
Hiro: minimal API + metric next week looks doable. UI follow-up in CFG-DRIFT-21.
Arman: thanks. small follow-up: keep a short TTL for verification results (24h) and archive on request.
